title: Complaints after a ticket release
description: Tickets for a small concert went on sale on Friday morning. Customers booked through the data centre nearest to them. A few days later, at the concert and by email, the venue received these messages. Nobody changed the system's code that week.

complaints.text: When I got to my seat, A4, someone else was sitting in it with a ticket for the same seat.
Another customer had a ticket for my seat, A6.
The site told me London was not responding, and I had to try again.
